# The Standard

> > Kenya's leading multimedia news organization providing breaking news, investigations, and stories from Kenya, East Africa, and the world.

The Standard Group Plc operates multiple publications including The Standard newspaper, The Nairobian, Eve Woman, Financial Standard, and broadcast channel KTN. Based in Nairobi on Mombasa Road, it serves as Kenya's premier source for news, business, lifestyle, and entertainment content across print, digital, and broadcast platforms.

## Key Topics

- The Standard Group Plc
- Kenya news and current affairs
- KTN broadcast network
- The Nairobian publication
- Eve Woman magazine
- Financial Standard business news
- East Africa regional coverage
- Nairobi headquarters
- Smart Harvest agricultural content
- Enterprise business reporting
- Pulse entertainment news
- Money Maker financial advice
- Sunday Magazine features
- Digital ePaper archives
